conclusion: Partially verified: The MISEV2023 guideline (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the reviewers' high-level conclusions that orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, transparent production reporting, and validated intact-EV assays are expected to de-risk identity/potency and lot-to-lot comparability. However, program-specific assertions that SGL-001 lacks particular documents/data (MCB/WCB reports, fit-for-purpose assay validations with LLOQ/specificity/precision, stability-indicating potency linked to in vivo PD, and ≥3 GMP-like bridging lots with release/stability/potency data) cannot be verified from the supplied evidence because MISEV2023 is a consensus guidance document and does not contain program-level manufacturing, assay validation, or batch comparability data.
unsupported_assertions: Any program-level statement that SGL-001 either meets or fails specific CMC deliverables (MCB/WCB characterization, validated orthogonal intact-EV QC assays with documented LLOQ/specificity/precision, stability-indicating potency assay linked to an in vivo PD endpoint, and reproducible release/stability/potency across ≥3 GMP-like batches) is unsupported by the cited evidence because MISEV2023 does not provide program-specific data.

Any assertion that MISEV2023 itself defines the exact analytical acceptance criteria (e.g., specific LLOQ values, numeric precision or specificity thresholds) needed to qualify assays or to declare lot comparability is unsupported; MISEV2023 provides consensus expectations but not prescriptive numerical acceptance criteria.
